name: claude-continuity
description: Local-first desktop app for importing Claude conversation exports and continuing them with the Anthropic API.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/main.js && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.js
